name: awesome-embedded-software
desc: :stars: List of software (HW interfaces, libs, protocols, etc) specifically suitable for resource-constrained Embedded Systems (low-memory and low-power) like 8-bit, 16-bit and 32-bit microcontrollers.

resources.name: wiselib
resources.desc: Generic algorithms library for heterogeneous, distributed, embedded systems.

resources.name: util.embedded
resources.desc: Useful support code for embedded development.

resources.name: embxx
resources.desc: Embedded C++ Library.

resources.name: embedded-libs
resources.desc: Libraries for embedded software (mainly for STM32).

resources.name: ETLCPP
resources.desc: Embedded Template Library where the user can declare the size, or maximum size of any object upfront.

resources.name: eFLL
resources.desc: Embedded Fuzzy Logic Library is a standard library for Embedded Systems.

resources.name: Collection of miscellaneous portable C snippets
resources.desc: Collection of miscellaneous portable C snippets.

resources.name: sc
resources.desc: Portable, stand-alone C libraries and data structures (C99).

resources.name: MicroTBX
resources.desc: Open source Microcontroller ToolBoX consisting of software components commonly needed in embedded software applications. MicroTBX is written in the C programming language (C99) with MISRA compliance in mind.

resources.name: umlibc
resources.desc: A bare-bones libc for memory constrained systems.

resources.name: µClibc-ng
resources.desc: Embedded C Library.

resources.name: Embedded Artistry's libc
resources.desc: A stripped-down C standard library implementation targeted for microcontroller-based embedded systems. Reduced set of functionality (due to embedded nature). Chosen for portability and quick bringup.

resources.name: HWlib
resources.desc: C++ OO micro-controller library for close-to-the-hardware programming.

resources.name: ctl
resources.desc: C Container Template Library. There is a fast compiling, type safe, header only, template-like container library for ISO C99/C11.

resources.name: FSMLang
resources.desc: State machine description language with C language generator. Supports flat and hierarchical machines and event subsystem.

resources.name: libmemory
resources.desc: Memory management library with implementations for malloc(), free(), and other useful memory management functions.

resources.name: lwmem
resources.desc: Lightweight dynamic memory manager library for embedded systems with memory constraints. It implements malloc, calloc, realloc and free functions.

resources.name: umm_malloc
resources.desc: Memory Manager For Small(ish) Microprocessors.

resources.name: o1heap
resources.desc: A highly deterministic constant-complexity memory allocator designed for hard real-time high-integrity embedded systems.

resources.name: EmbeddedProto
resources.desc: C++ Protocol Buffers implementation specifically suitable for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. It is small, reliable and easy to use.

resources.name: protobuf-embedded-c
resources.desc: Protocol buffers generator for resource constrained embedded applications written in the C programming language.

resources.name: LwRB
resources.desc: Lightweight generic ring buffer manager library.

resources.name: RingBuffer
resources.desc: Simple Interrupt Safe Ring (Circular) Buffer Queuing Library for Embedded platforms.

resources.name: lfbb
resources.desc: Lock-free bipartite buffer, a variant of the ring buffer which can always provide contigous space inside the buffer for reading, writing or modifying the data in-place.

resources.name: fifofast
resources.desc: A fast, generic fifo for MCUs.

resources.name: lwext4
resources.desc: An ext2/ext3/ext4 filesystem library for microcontrollers.

resources.name: FatFS
resources.desc: FAT filesystem implementation.

resources.name: LevelX
resources.desc: Provides Flash Wear Leveling for FileX and Stand Alone purposes.

resources.name: ufat
resources.desc: Low-memory feature-complete VFAT implementation.

resources.name: fat_io_lib
resources.desc: Small footprint, low dependency, C code implementation of a FAT16 & FAT32 driver.

resources.name: SdFat
resources.desc: Arduino FAT16/FAT32 exFAT Library.

resources.name: fat32
resources.desc: Lighweight FAT32 file system written in C with no thirdparty dependencies. It requires a small port which provide functions for initializing, reading and writing to the MSD.

resources.name: emfat
resources.desc: FAT32 emulation library for stm32f4.

resources.name: OpenFAT
resources.desc: FAT filesystem implementation for embedded processors.

resources.name: uC-FS

resources.name: littlefs
resources.desc: Little fail-safe filesystem designed for microcontrollers.

resources.name: UFFS

resources.name: FlashDB

resources.name: PureDB

resources.name: UnQLite

resources.name: microkvs
resources.desc: Tiny key-value store for persisting configuration data on microcontrollers.

resources.name: EasyFlash
resources.desc: Lightweight embedded flash memory library.

resources.name: FlashAlgo
resources.desc: Framework for building Arm Cortex-M "FLM" style flash programming algorithms.

resources.name: FCB
resources.desc: Flash Circular Buffer provides an abstraction through which you can treat flash like a FIFO.

resources.name: nanoPB
resources.desc: Small code-size Protocol Buffers implementation in ANSI C. It is especially suitable for use in microcontrollers, but fits any memory restricted system.

resources.name: interchange
resources.desc: Request/response mechanism for embedded development, using atomics.

resources.name: xmodem

resources.name: TinyFrame

resources.name: nanoMODBUS

resources.name: aem-modbus-simulator

resources.name: rcobs

resources.name: RadioHead
resources.desc: Packet Radio library for embedded microprocessors.

resources.desc: Packet Radio library for embedded microprocessors with docs.

resources.name: LwIP

resources.name: HttpClient

resources.name: Arm Mbed OS
